source.notes: GEDTM30 v1.2.0, Ho and Hengl / OpenGeoHub, CC BY 4.0. Predicted bare-earth regional DTM, native 1 arc second (~30m); bilinear 65x65 extraction. Not surveyed road, bridge, stand or tunnel elevations.

previousElevation.notes: GEDTM30 v1.2 约30m地面高程估算，65×65双线性取样；真实米制高差，不放大。用于减少建筑与植被表面干扰，仍非赛道路面、看台基础或桥隧测绘。

runtimeSource.notes: IGN RGE ALTI via Géoplateforme, native1m product sampled about8×10m then resampled to the existing frame. Acquisition density/date/accuracy vary or are unknown; four edge nodes use retained direct API queries. Not a road/bridge/platform survey.

runtimeNotes: IGN RGE ALTI区域地面候选，原生产品1m格距、API采样约8×10m，保留真实米制高差；129×129重采样，4个边缘点来自独立直接查询。采集密度/日期与垂直精度不明或变化，不是赛道路面、桥隧、看台平台测绘。

nativeWindow.rowOrder: south to north; columns west to east

acquisitionPalette: LiDAR Topo externe densité acquisition théorique non renseignée ou inférieure à 1 pt / m²

sceneAcceptance.scope: Five available zones default real-pass photos in three Edge viewport/device emulations, plus Z normal entry and drag/map separation. Not every-seat visibility certification.
